cd /home/runner/workspace/ai-agent
node - <<'NODE'
const fs=require('node:fs');
for(const [file,b64] of [
 ['backend/extension/3D_viewer.js',''],
 ['backend/extension/3D_viewer.test.js','']
]) {
 if(!fs.existsSync(file)) throw Error('Missing '+file);
 if(file.endsWith('/3D_viewer.js') && !fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8').includes('Frontend3DViewer')) throw Error('Unexpected file '+file);
 const next=Buffer.from(b64,'base64').toString('utf8');
 fs.writeFileSync(file,next);
 console.log('PET_FRONT_EDGE_ROUTE_INSTALLED',file,next.length);
}
if(!fs.readFileSync('frontend/index.html','utf8').includes('/extension/3D_viewer.js')) throw Error('3D frontend script missing');
NODE
node --check backend/extension/3D_viewer.js
node backend/extension/3D_viewer.test.js
